description: Preferred runway modes, owner-supplied 24-10-2026, in priority order (order in this file is the tie-break): equal first 02A20D, 02A2027D and 0209A20D; then 02AD; then 20AD. 02A2027D departs on both 20 and 27; 0209A20D arrives on both 02 and 09. No crosswind limit or capacity has been supplied for any mode; they fall back to the pack default and have no capacity limit.
